During the [[Raid at Bakura]], this '''GR-75 medium transport''', alongside [[Unidentified GR-75 medium transport 1|two]] [[Unidentified GR-75 medium transport 3|others]], was involved in rescuing prisoners from Bakura.

==History==
After [[Rogue Leader/Legends|Rogue Leader]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] disabled one of the [[Imperial Dropship Transport/Legends|Imperial transports]] attempting to flee the system upon [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron's]] arrival, and shortly after the first transport successfully extracted the prisoners, the [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transport]] exited hyperspace and arrived at the location of the Imperial transport and docked with it. The ship's commander then confirmed that it has docked with the transport and is transferring the prisoners onto its own ship as they spoke. It then relayed to Rogue Squadron requesting for backup as it was being swarmed by various TIEs. Upon successfully retrieving the prisoners, the GR-75 transport then left the ship and proceeded to jump into hyperspace, with the commanding officer thanking Rogue Squadron for their support.
